title: Recover the rejected cargo
description: Complete the loading dock’s consuming handoff. Accept a capsule whose destination is nonzero and whose payload length fits the dock’s per-capsule limit. Store it and return its zero-based position and destination. On rejection, return the original capsule with its allocation intact. Check the destination first when both checks fail. A valid destination with an empty payload is allowed.
signature: Dock::submit(&mut self, cargo: Capsule) -> Result<Receipt, (RejectReason, Capsule)>

title: Borrow two disjoint registers
description: Return mutable references to two distinct elements in the caller’s requested order. Return None for equal indices or any out-of-range index. Use safe slice splitting to turn a checked inequality into two exclusive borrows. The function should work with move-only elements.
signature: two_mut<T>(slice: &mut [T], first: usize, second: usize) -> Option<(&mut T, &mut T)>
promptMatch: two arbitrary indices in a slice

title: Inspect a temporary manifest
description: Decode owned records from lines of the form station:count, trimming both fields. A station must be nonempty and count must parse as u16. Return the one-based line number on malformed input. An empty input contains zero records. After every line validates, invoke the visitor once with a temporary slice and return its result. The visitor can return a caller-owned reference captured independently of the records.
signature: inspect_manifest<R, F>(input: &str, visit: F) -> Result<R, ParseError> where F: for<'scope> FnOnce(&'scope [Record]) -> R

title: Retire stale atlas handles
description: Complete a dense arena with a separate slot table. A handle identifies a slot generation, and the slot points to its current position in dense storage. Repair that mapping when swap removal moves a surviving record. Advance a deleted slot’s u8 generation before making it reusable. Prefer a reusable slot over a new slot and retire exhausted slots. Use each handle with its originating arena.
signature: Arena<T>::insert(&mut self, value: T) -> Handle | get(&self, handle: Handle) -> Option<&T> | remove(&mut self, handle: Handle) -> Option<T>

title: Route across borrowed trait objects
description: Route a payload through mutable trait-object references. Try each sink in input order. A Busy result advances to the next sink, while Invalid stops routing and reports that index. Success returns the accepting index. Empty or wholly busy input returns NoAvailableSink. The caller keeps ownership of every sink and the payload.
signature: route(sinks: &mut [&mut dyn Sink], payload: &[u8]) -> Result<usize, RouteError>

title: Lend overlapping mutable windows
description: Implement a lending iterator over windows of a mutable slice. Advance the start by one after each successful window. Width zero and widths larger than the remaining region produce no window. Each window borrows the iterator for that call, so the next window can overlap once the caller finishes using the previous one.

title: Return approval only before handoff
description: Validate a draft by checking its nonzero destination before its payload length. A payload may be as large as the limit. Failed validation returns the draft intact. Dispatch consumes an approved ticket. Capacity rejection before handoff returns that approval intact. A lost acknowledgment after handoff carries only the stable operation ID as uncertain evidence, and confirmation carries the ID as a receipt.
signature: Ticket<Draft>::approve(self, limit: usize) -> Result<Ticket<Approved>, (ValidationError, Self)> | Ticket<Approved>::dispatch(self, outcome: Handoff) -> DispatchResult

title: Keep the pool invariant under one lock
description: Implement capacity admission, close, and permit destruction. A snapshot must report occupied plus free equal to capacity. Admission succeeds only while open and below capacity. Closing an empty pool closes it immediately. Otherwise it drains and rejects new work until the final owned permit drops. Dropping a permit releases one slot, including during a drain.
signature: Admission::try_admit(&self) -> Option<Permit> | close(&self) -> Phase | Permit::drop(&mut self)
promptMatch: Two counters represent free slots and occupied slots

title: Give each poll a work budget
description: Implement an owned future that computes a wrapping u64 sum of its bytes. Each poll processes the next 64 bytes or all remaining bytes if fewer. Return Ready with the sum as soon as the final byte is consumed. If work remains, request another poll using the current waker and return Pending. Repeated polls after completion return the stored answer without requesting another poll.
signature: BudgetSum::poll(self: Pin<&mut Self>, cx: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<u64>

title: Resume a cancelled frame write
description: Keep an unfinished frame and its offset in Exporter. A flush poll asks the sink to accept one suffix. Pending keeps the offset unchanged. A valid positive count advances it, and a short write schedules another poll. Zero with bytes remaining returns NoProgress. A count beyond the offered slice returns InvalidCount. Both errors preserve the local offset. While a frame remains pending, begin returns any new frame unchanged. An empty frame completes immediately.
signature: Exporter::begin(&mut self, bytes: Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), Vec<u8>> | async flush<S: Sink>(&mut self, sink: &mut S) -> Result<(), FlushError>

title: Decode the wire format explicitly
description: Implement a codec for the Mimic Packet. The header contains a one-byte tag of 1 or 2, a little-endian u32 sequence, and a little-endian u16 payload length. Decode one borrowed frame and report its consumed byte count, leaving subsequent bytes available. An available invalid tag is an error immediately. Missing header or payload bytes are incomplete. Encode the same layout, rejecting an invalid tag before checking length.
signature: decode(input: &[u8]) -> Decode<'_> | encode(tag: u8, sequence: u32, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, EncodeError>

title: Track initialized slots independently
description: Build the safe model of the scattered assembly. Insert move-only values at arbitrary indices. Duplicate and out-of-range insertions return the incoming value with a distinct error. A complete finish transfers an array in index order. An incomplete finish returns the original assembly, including all stored values. The empty assembly finishes immediately.
signature: Assembly<T, N>::insert(&mut self, index: usize, value: T) -> Result<(), InsertError<T>> | finish(self) -> Result<[T; N], Self>

title: Merge a proposal without publishing it
description: Implement the overlay operations for local savepoints. Reads search from the newest layer to the base and stop at the first entry, including a deletion. Merge moves the newest changes into its immediate parent. Rollback drops that newest layer. Both return false at the root. Only a store commit with no open savepoint can publish, after checking its original snapshot and version.
signature: Transaction::get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<i64> | begin_savepoint(&mut self) | merge_savepoint(&mut self) -> bool | rollback_savepoint(&mut self) -> bool

title: Send the maximum sequence exactly once
description: Complete send on an established in-memory connection. A payload at most 1,024 bytes may use the current sequence, including u32::MAX exactly once. After that the connection is exhausted. A rejected send returns the original payload and leaves sequence and transcript intact. Check oversized payloads before checking exhaustion. Closing consumes the established connection and appends one Close frame.
signature: Connection<Established>::send(&mut self, payload: Vec<u8>) -> Result<u32, (SendError, Vec<u8>)>
promptMatch: sequence number may be used exactly once
